definitions.explanation: The act of restoring something that is broken or damaged to good condition.

examples.japanese: {車|くるま}を{修理|しゅうり}に{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I sent my car in for repair.

examples.japanese: {時計|とけい}を{修理|しゅうり}してもらった。
この{古|ふる}いパソコンは{修理|しゅうり}するより{新|あたら}しいのを{買|か}った{方|ほう}が{安|やす}いかもしれない。{部品|ぶひん}がもう{手|て}に{入|はい}らないそうだ。
examples.english: It might be cheaper to buy a new computer than to repair this old one. They say the parts are no longer available.

notes:
{修理|しゅうり} means repair or fixing things that are broken or damaged.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {修理|しゅうり}する (to repair)
- {修理|しゅうり}に{出|だ}す (to send for repair)
- {修理|しゅうり}してもらう (to have something repaired)
- {修理|しゅうり}{中|ちゅう} (under repair)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {修理|しゅうり}{代|だい} / {修理|しゅうり}{費|ひ} (repair cost)
- {修理|しゅうり}{工場|こうじょう} (repair shop)
- {修理|しゅうり}{業者|ぎょうしゃ} (repair service provider)
- {修理|しゅうり}{不能|ふのう} (beyond repair)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {修理|しゅうり}: repair (general, machines, buildings)
- {修繕|しゅうぜん}: repair, restoration (buildings, older usage)
- {直|なお}す: to fix (casual, everyday)
- {補修|ほしゅう}: maintenance, repair (roads, buildings)
